correctionLoops.summary: Login shell overrode Node24 with Volta Node25.
Concurrent installs corrupted the dependency tree; stopped own installers and ran clean npm ci.
Signing-key CLI argument began with hyphens; regenerated keys using the option terminator.
Optional catchall did not match root; added index route.
Password provider duplicate-email behavior and customization placement needed correction.
Copied harness omitted its imported schema helper; added AJV2020 shim over unchanged schema.
RNWeb dropped kit accessibility values; mirrored values to ARIA.
Video preview needed a decoded first frame.
Feed tabs were not reachable from profile/thread; moved to persistent shell.
Overlapping M2 choreography produced a mixed stream; isolated rerun retained.
Repeated router pushes accumulated root surfaces; switched to replacement.
Default starter group has Erin without a harness browser; recorded exact default-case skip and used documented three-person group adapter.
M5 selected controls lacked web selected state; added explicit ARIA mirrors.
Cache scope and view-once history identifiers needed tightening.
Background observer reads root URI attributes while kit renders child image; mirrored the actual URI.
Terminated M5 harness retained timer and contaminated shared receipts; unique raw paths and exact-PID termination fixed it.
Native picker JSX delimiters failed typecheck; corrected.
Expo native no-bundler launch selected default8081 URL; subsequent launches explicitly use49200. No8081 server was started.
RN global window lacked browser event methods; feature detection fixed native launch crash.
Expo rejected port with no-bundler; reused existing Metro with explicit port.
Extra dev command refused the running local backend; existing watcher had already deployed.
FeedCard lacked observable selected state for M8 unliked selection; mirrored actual state.
M8 home route needed discoverable chat rows; added actual chat section.
Admin migration used root config against scale URL; refused with BadAdminKey, corrected cwd.
Scale migration raced watcher deployment; retried after functions ready.
Media verifier used persona.handle instead of persona.id; corrected credential lookup.
Media verifier output directory was relative to wrong cwd; rerun in scale directory.
Cached messages and quotes needed read-time expiry, and native view-once needed an in-memory data URI.
Scale write-probe cleanup raced deployment; rerun after ready removed only exact generated keys.
